title: Hom. 21: Nazareth sermon (Luke 4:16-21)
english: In the synagogue he reads Isaiah: Spirit upon me to proclaim good news to the poor. [[Today this scripture is fulfilled in your hearing >> Bible:Luke 4:21]] — the jubilee stands in him.

added_allusions.reason: Today this scripture is fulfilled in your hearing

translator_notes: Copy-text Jerome Latin of Luke Homilies (Rauer GCS 35 tradition); no ANF 9 Patrick wording.
True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B.

title: Hom. 22: Rejected at Nazareth (Luke 4:22-30)
english: Familiarity breeds contempt; Elijah and Elisha helped outsiders. Truth is not bound to hometown pride; they drive him out, but his hour is not theirs to set.

english: He teaches with authority and rebukes unclean spirits. The Word’s command is not like the scribes’; creation’s rebels know his voice.
